{{Quote|Shadows Six, Seven, and Ten were caught in the ray.|Ahsoka Tano|<ref name="som" />}}
Serving in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], "'''Shadow Seven'''" was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] in [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. When the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] learned about the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], which had disabled and destroyed several Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] using its [[Ion pulse cannon/Legends|ion cannons]], [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] devised a plan to stop the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] from [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|destroying]] the [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]]. Skywalker led Shadow Squadron, including Shadow Seven, through the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]] in order to arrive at the [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenter]] before the ''Malevolence''.

When the Republic forces reached their target, several [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]] were launched from the ''Malevolence'' to engage the approaching Republic [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]]. Soon after, the ''Malevolence'' launched an ion ray toward Shadow Squadron, which was forced to take evasive actions. Shadow Seven was one of the [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] caught in the ray, leaving their bomber disabled in [[Realspace/Legends|space]].

==Biography==
===Preparing the attack===
{{Quote|All right, boys, let's go.|Anakin Skywalker to Shadow Squadron, as they prepare to jump into hyperspace|<ref name="som" />}}
[[File:Skywalker_briefs_Shadow_Squadron.png|thumb|left|250px|Skywalker briefs Shadow Squadron on the attack plan.]]
The [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] using the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] "Shadow Seven" served in [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]], a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]].<ref name="som" /> A [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], Shadow Seven was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="db" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Legends-Date">{{TCWdates|103}}</ref> during the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] learned about the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']],<ref name="rm">{{TCW|Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence''}}</ref> an enormous [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]],<ref name="tcwcg">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> after the [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]] had [[Battle of Abregado/Legends|destroyed]] a task force in the [[Abregado system/Legends|Abregado system]].<ref name="rm" /> 

[[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] devised a plan to stop the ''Malevolence'', which possessed twin [[Ion pulse cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] capable of neutralizing the power of enemy [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. After the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]], commanded by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], [[Battle of the Ryndellia system/Legends|destroyed]] a Republic medical convoy in the [[Ryndellia system/Legends|Ryndellia system]], Skywalker assumed that the ''Malevolence'' was on its way to the [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]], where over 60,000 wounded [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] were being treated. Skywalker, together with his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], would lead Shadow Squadron, including Shadow Seven, to a [[Balmorra Run/Legends|shortcut]] through the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]] in order to arrive at the [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenter]] before the ''Malevolence''.<ref name="som" />

===The mission===
{{Quote|Charge the ion cannon and prepare to fire.|General Grievous ordering the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droids]] of his [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] crew to target Shadow Squadron|<ref name="som" />}}
[[File:Battle of Kaliida.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Shadow Squadron attacking the ''Malevolence'']]
Piloting recently-acquired [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]],<ref name="procedure">''[[The Clone Wars: Procedure]]''</ref> Shadow Seven and their fellow [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] departed from the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']]. Before jumping to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], Skywalker contacted all pilots, who checked in with the General. Shadow Squadron eventually emerged from hyperspace, and the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] led the unit into the Kaliida Nebula. Skywalker, however, was unaware of the [[Neebray/Legends|neebrays]] inhabiting the [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]], but the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] was able to evade the massive creatures without taking any casualties. Shadow Seven and the rest of Shadow Squadron piloted their [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] out from the nebula, arriving at the Kaliida Shoals Medical center.<ref name="som" />

When the ''Malevolence'' emerged from hyperspace and approached the medical [[Space station/Legends|station]], Skywalker led the squadron toward the battleship. Several [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]] were launched from the ''Malevolence'' to [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|engage]] the approaching Republic starfighters, and Grievous ordered the crew of the ship to fire one of the ion cannons despite the Confederate starfighter presence. As the ion ray approached Shadow Squadron, the squadron took evasive action to evade the ray. However, Shadow Seven was unable to pilot the Y-wing starfighter away in [[Time/Legends|time]]. Their fighter was left disabled in [[Realspace/Legends|space]], while the remains of the squadron continued its attack on the ''Malevolence'', eventually crippling its starboard ion cannon. The cruiser retreated from the battle, sparing the Kaliida Shoals medical center from destruction.<ref name="som" />

==Personality and traits==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] clone, Shadow Seven stood at 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="db" /> They had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]],<ref name="som" /> and tan skin.<ref name="Skin" /> When the ''Malevolence'' fired one of its ion cannons toward Shadow Squadron during the Battle of the Kaliida Nebula, Shadow Seven was unable to evade the ion ray in time, leaving their starfighter disabled in space.<ref name="som" />

==Skills and abilities==
Shadow Seven was an effective pilot and was able to maneuver their Y-wing through the neebray mantas nesting in the Kaliida Nebula. However, they could not fly their Y-wing out of the range of the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} ion cannon, before it was incapacitated.<ref name="som" />

==Equipment==
The clone pilot was equipped with [[Color|white]] [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] and a helmet with the [[Republic crest/Legends|Republic crest]] on both sides.<ref name="som" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shadow Seven first appeared in "[[Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence'']]," an episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which aired on [[October 10]], [[2008]].<ref name="epguide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode003.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Shadow of ''Malevolence''}}</ref> Like all clone troopers in the series,<ref name="DBB CtQK">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20091120.html|text=Dee Bradley Baker: From Clones to Queen Karina}}</ref> Shadow Seven was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].<ref name="epguide" />
